state.question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.
state.summary: Determine the chronological order of clips based on the sequence of forming a rice ball, pressing rice onto salmon to make sushi, and adding a topping with chopsticks.

events.description: Chef shapes rice mound on wooden board. Salmon slice and wasabi are visible nearby.
Chef forms sushi by pressing rice onto salmon slice with both hands.
Chef continues shaping sushi, adjusting rice and fish with hands.
Chef refines sushi shape, pressing and rotating salmon with fingers.
Person places salmon slice on wooden board, then moves hand away. Rice and wasabi remain stationary.
Chef uses chopsticks to place topping on rice, then pauses and looks forward.
Chef shapes rice mound into a ball with right hand. Left hand holds small object.
Chef looks up, holds formed rice ball in right hand, left hand open.
Close-up: Chef's right hand holds rice ball. Left hand near cutting board. Salmon slice visible.
Person places salmon slice on wooden board, holding rice ball in other hand.
Person lifts salmon slice, leaving it on board. Rice ball remains held.

turns.summary: Determine the sequence of rice mound shaping and salmon placement using available slots.

focus_intent.evidence_goal: Which event occurs first: rice mound shaping or salmon placement?
focus_intent.next_probe_goal: Which event occurs first: salmon placement or topping placement?
